_source: Harish's homework batches 1+2 (04-Aug .. 30-Sep-2026): most trades are 8 EMA trades. Candle CLOSES above the 8 EMA + follow-through = buy CE; closes below + follow-through = buy PE. SL = the signal candle's low (CE) / high (PE). Exits: trail under each candle, doji, Bollinger band touch, day high/low. Edit numbers here, not in code.

signal._rule: Signal candle = the first close on the other side of the 8 EMA (previous close was on this side or on the EMA). body_min_share: the signal candle's body must be at least this share of its range (skips dojis as signals). start/end: candle start times allowed. stage3: also signal when price is already on that side, the candle pulls back into the 8 EMA (within stage3_touch_points) and closes away from it in the trend direction.

trigger._rule: Follow-through = a later candle trades beyond the signal candle's high (CE) / low (PE) by buffer_points within trigger_bars candles, same day. No break = no trade.

risk._rule: SL = signal candle low (CE) / high (PE) -/+ sl_buffer_points. Trades with SL smaller than min or bigger than max are skipped (bigger = the signal candle was too long; your homework skips those too). stop_slip_points: the break entry and SL / TSL / doji exits fill this much worse than the level (keeps the backtest honest).

exit._rule: trail: from the next candle the SL follows each closed candle's low (CE) / high (PE) - your TSL. doji: a doji (body <= doji_body_share of range) forms -> exit on the break of its low (CE) / high (PE). bb: exit when price touches the Bollinger band (bb_period, bb_std) on the trade side. ema: close back through the 8 EMA. All out by exit_by.
exit._beginner: cap mode = your beginner plan: TSL under each 15-min candle low (CE) / high (PE), book everything at +max_points. The journal marks whether the trade reached +15 / +20 (beginner_points) before the exit.

tags._rule: Shown with every signal and split out in the backtest - NOT filters until the backtest says so. gap_points: open vs previous close. max_entry_of_day: your 'avoid the late 3rd entry' rule is tagged when this side already had this many trades today.

timeframes_rule: Only 15-min: add "5m", "3m" here to bring those back.

filters._rule: Used by ema8_filtered.py. Set any of trend / separation / max_sl / no_lunch / day_limits / exit to false to switch it off. trend_ema_span 80 on 15-min = 1-hour EMA 20. cost_points_per_trade = brokerage + slippage taken off every trade. train_until = last date of the tuning years.

pa1._rule: Used by pa1_strategy.py (Price Action Strategy 1 notes v4.1). bb_slope_*: UBB/LBB slope over N candles decides the bias; rangebound_width: BB width below this = Stage 1, no 8 EMA trades. t1/t2: the +15 / +20 exit columns. cost_to_cost_at: SL to entry in the trail column. level_near_pts: signal candle low/high this close to PDH/PDL/PDC/pivot/wick = at a level.
pa1._sl_mode: signal = signal candle low/high (your rule). follow = the follow-through candle's low/high (tighter, Sushen 'previous candle' at entry). mixed_by_mid: when both bands expand (breakout), buy above the BB middle line, sell below.
